tokens.name: color-frame
tokens.usage: Hairline around the app shell.

tokens.name: color-input
tokens.usage: Deepest well: the log viewer and command palette input.

tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: Main content background.

tokens.name: color-rail
tokens.usage: The icon rail, one step lighter than canvas.

tokens.name: color-surface-inset
tokens.usage: Rows and inputs placed inside a card; table header.

tokens.name: color-bubble
tokens.usage: Segmented and tab containers, small pills on canvas.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Card body (end of the card gradient).

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows; skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: color-surface-top
tokens.usage: Card top (start of the card gradient); selected segment.

tokens.name: color-track
tokens.usage: Progress and pipeline tracks, disabled fills.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Static outlines: panels, rows, inputs at rest.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Icon wells and pills that need definition.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focused non-edge-light inputs.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, values, body on canvas and every surface (≥15:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, list items, icons at rest on canvas and surfaces (≥8:1).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta, timestamps, placeholders, inactive rail icons on canvas and surfaces (≥5:1). The lowest tier for readable information.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Disabled only. Never for information the user needs.

tokens.name: text-on-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any aurora surface (≥7:1).

tokens.name: aurora-1
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 1, amber: the leading edge of the brand gradient.

tokens.name: aurora-2
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 2, apricot.

tokens.name: aurora-3
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 3, pearl: the bright centre that makes aurora read as light.

tokens.name: aurora-4
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 4, blush.

tokens.name: aurora-5
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 5, pink.

tokens.name: aurora-6
tokens.usage: Aurora dusk stop 6, rose: the trailing edge.

tokens.name: edge-warm
tokens.usage: Edge light, leading (warm) end. Interactive outlines only.

tokens.name: edge-cool
tokens.usage: Edge light, trailing (cool violet) end. Interactive outlines only.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: Category: live / succeeded. Dot, icon, flare, progress fill.

tokens.name: accent-success
tokens.usage: Vivid success badge fill in the activity feed (with dark check).

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Category: building / running; also the focus ring and primary data series.

tokens.name: accent-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Blue at small sizes: dots under 6px, quick-action icons.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Category: awaiting approval. Saturated amber is a state, never the brand (the brand is the pale aurora).

tokens.name: accent-amber-soft
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval at small sizes (dots).

tokens.name: accent-coral
tokens.usage: Category: failed; destructive text actions.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Category: queued. Icons and flares (≥1.5px strokes).

tokens.name: accent-violet-soft
tokens.usage: Queued at small sizes (dots).

tokens.name: accent-danger
tokens.usage: Notification badge and the solid fill of a destructive confirm button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on accent-danger fills (4.9:1).

tokens.name: solid-dark
tokens.usage: Solid dark pill: the primary action on an aurora card.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind overlays (slide-over, dialog, command palette), with a light 8px blur.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Poppins for Latin and numerals, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic (the browser falls back per glyph). Weights 300–600; never bold. Arabic runs about 1.1× the Latin size.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body 15px / 1.6 for Arabic. Hierarchy by size and color, not weight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: النسخة دي مستنية موافقة مسؤول البيئة قبل ما توصل للعملاء.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Rail tooltips, chips, search placeholder, table rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, table headers, “View all”.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Logs, hashes, versions and YAML. Always LTR.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; inside pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards; card header to body; rail item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Widget card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Stat card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content column gap; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of a page under the top bar.

radius.note: Containers tighten as they nest (28 → 16 → 12 → 10); controls are pills or circles.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles inside rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs, chips, log viewer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The approval (aurora) card, dialogs, command palette.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The app frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search, segmented controls, rail items, avatars.

shadow.note: No grey drop shadows under cards. Cards are lit from above; only data and the approval moment glow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card: a 1px top highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Slide-over, dialog and palette over the backdrop.

layout.note: Shell: icon rail + one workspace + slide-over panels.

tokens.name: layout-rail
tokens.usage: Icon rail width.

tokens.name: layout-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: layout-panel
tokens.usage: Slide-over width on desktop.

tokens.name: layout-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards.
